description: An AIA-style application for payment on a construction contract: the G702 summary page (application and certificate for payment) and its G703 continuation sheet, which breaks the contract into a schedule of values with work completed, retainage and balance to finish per line.

application.description: Identifying details of the pay application, as given in the G702 and G703 headers.

owner_name.description: The owner the application is addressed to (the 'TO (OWNER)' block), e.g. a city or developer.

contractor_name.description: The contractor or construction manager submitting the application (the 'FROM' block).

project_name.description: Project name as printed, joining all of its lines with spaces.

period_to.description: The end of the billing period ('PERIOD TO' or 'PERIOD ENDING'), as printed.

payment_summary.description: The numbered lines of the G702 application for payment. Amounts in dollars as numbers.

original_contract_sum.description: Line 1: the original contract sum or committed cost.

net_change_by_change_orders.description: Line 2: net change by change orders.

contract_sum_to_date.description: Line 3: contract sum to date (line 1 + line 2).

total_completed_and_stored_to_date.description: Line 4: total completed and stored to date.

retainage_percent.description: Line 5a: the retainage percentage applied to completed work, e.g. 5 for 5%.

less_previous_certificates.description: Line 7: less previous certificates for payment.

balance_to_finish_including_retainage.description: Line 9: balance to finish, plus retainage.

schedule_of_values.description: Every line of the G703 continuation sheet's schedule of values, in the order printed. Excludes the totals row. Amounts in parentheses are negative.

items.description: One line item of the schedule of values.

item_number.description: Item number exactly as printed in the ITEM NO. column, e.g. '#2300' or 'Fee'.

change_orders.description: Change orders to this line; negative when printed in parentheses.

revised_scheduled_value.description: Revised scheduled value (scheduled value plus change orders).

work_completed_from_previous_application.description: Work completed as of the previous application.

total_completed_and_stored_to_date.description: Total completed and stored to date.

percent_complete.description: Percent complete as printed, e.g. 63 for 63%.

totals.description: The totals row at the foot of the G703 continuation sheet.

work_completed_from_previous_application.description: Total work completed from previous applications.

total_completed_and_stored_to_date.description: Total completed and stored to date.
